blocks.markdown: Minimum solicitation period for ITQs , RFSAs and urgent procurements Applicable trade agreements Minimum solicitation period for ITQs and RFSAs Minimum solicitation period for urgent procurements None No minimum period Less than 15 calendar days Canadian Free Trade Agreement only No minimum period Less than 15 calendar days One or more international trade agreements 25 calendar days 10 calendar days when an urgent procurement is substantiated and the urgency renders the normal solicitation period impracticable. Less than 10 calendar days if limited tendering is used. Further guidance can be found in Request for supply arrangement .
